entities.name: Alexis González
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Alexis Rubén González is an Argentine male volleyball player. He was part of the Argentina men's national volleyball team. He competed with the national team at the 2012 Summer Olympics in London, Great Britain. He played with Club Ciudad de Bolívar in 2012.
